points.quote: | `common` | Any environment: browser, Node, Electron, worker | Only other `common` code. It can't use the DOM or Node APIs. |
| `browser` | A browser or renderer with a DOM, including the web build | `common` and `browser` |
| `node` | A Node.js process: extension host, server, shared process, CLI | `common` and `node` |

| `electron-browser` (formerly `electron-sandbox`) | The sandboxed Electron renderer window | `common`, `browser` and `electron-browser`. It has no direct Node access and reaches the main process through IPC or preload globals. |
| `electron-main` | The Electron main process | `common`, `node` and `electron-main`, plus the `electron` API |
